nodes.label: National Greenhouse and Energy Reporting Act
nodes.description: Establishes a national framework for reporting greenhouse gas emissions and energy production and consumption. AlburyCity must submit annual NGER reports for facilities meeting threshold criteria including AWMC.

metadata.reportingThreshold: 25,000 tCO2-e per facility or 50,000 tCO2-e corporate

nodes.label: Product Stewardship Act 2011
nodes.description: Provides a framework for shared responsibility across the product lifecycle, including voluntary, co-regulatory and mandatory stewardship schemes. Relevant to e-waste, tyres, packaging and other priority products accepted at AWMC.

nodes.label: Export Waste Ban
nodes.description: Commonwealth ban effective 1 July 2021 prohibiting export of waste glass, paper/cardboard, plastics and tyres. Drives domestic reprocessing infrastructure demand including facilities like C&D MRF and IVC.

metadata.enforcingBody: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water

nodes.label: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Act 1999
nodes.description: Australia's principal environmental legislation protecting matters of national environmental significance including threatened species and ecological communities. Relevant to new landfill site development and major infrastructure projects near sensitive habitats.

metadata.triggerThreshold: Actions with significant impact on MNES require federal approval
metadata.regulatoryBody: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water

nodes.label: Climate Active Framework
nodes.description: Australian Government voluntary certification program for organisations achieving net zero emissions. Council participation would require certified carbon neutral status across Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions.

metadata.administrator: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water

nodes.label: Protection of the Environment Operations Act 1997
nodes.description: NSW principal environment protection legislation establishing the licensing system for scheduled activities including landfill operations. AWMC operates under an Environment Protection Licence (EPL) issued under this Act.

nodes.label: NSW Waste and Sustainable Materials Strategy 2041
nodes.description: NSW long-term strategy setting targets to halve waste to landfill by 2030, achieve 80% recovery of all materials and transition to a circular economy. AlburyCity's 80% diversion target by 2030 aligns with this state framework.

keyTargets.2030: Halve waste to landfill, 80% recovery rate

nodes.label: Plastic Reduction and Circular Economy Act
nodes.description: NSW legislation phasing out problematic single-use plastics and establishing circular economy principles. Affects AWMC waste stream composition and downstream reprocessing obligations.

nodes.label: Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016
nodes.description: NSW legislation for biodiversity conservation establishing the Biodiversity Offsets Scheme. Any new landfill site development or major infrastructure expansion must assess biodiversity impacts and may require offsets.

nodes.label: Local Land Services Act 2013
nodes.description: NSW legislation governing land management across rural areas including native vegetation management and land clearing approvals. Relevant to council landholdings used for climate adaptation actions such as revegetation or carbon sequestration.

nodes.label: NSW Climate Change (Net Zero Future) Act 2022
nodes.description: NSW legislation enshrining net zero emissions by 2050 and 70% reduction by 2035 relative to 2005 levels. AlburyCity's corporate targets must be consistent with and report against this state framework.

nodes.label: NSW Climate Change Adaptation Strategy
nodes.description: NSW whole-of-government strategy for managing climate risks across communities, economy and environment. Provides the state framework within which AlburyCity's local Climate Change Adaptation Strategy must be situated.

nodes.label: AlburyCity Waste Management Strategy 2022-2027
nodes.description: AlburyCity's five-year operational strategy covering AWMC landfill management, diversion targets, infrastructure pipeline (IVC, MBT, C&D MRF) and 54 actions across four strategic themes. Current diversion rate ~62-63%, target 80% by 2030.

nodes.label: RAMJO Regional Resource Recovery Strategy 2022-2027
nodes.description: Regional strategy coordinated by Riverina and Murray Joint Organisation covering shared waste infrastructure and resource recovery across member councils including AlburyCity. Informs regional-scale solutions for materials the single-council approach cannot economically support.

nodes.label: Environmental Sustainability Framework and Action Plan 2024
nodes.description: AlburyCity's overarching sustainability framework adopted March 2024 setting corporate emission reduction targets and 54+ actions across energy, transport, waste and natural environment. LSO 2.1 commits to Scope 3 inclusion in future carbon targets.

nodes.label: Climate Change Adaptation Strategy 2021-2025
nodes.description: AlburyCity's current adaptation strategy covering flood, storm, heatwave and fire risk management. Does not reflect obligations arising from Council's climate emergency declaration of March 2022, which post-dates adoption.

nodes.label: Net Zero Fleet Transition Plan 2022
nodes.description: AlburyCity plan for transitioning the corporate vehicle and plant fleet to low and zero emission alternatives. Fleet decarbonisation is a key Scope 1 lever under ESFAP targets.

metadata.fleetScope: Corporate light vehicles and heavy plant

nodes.label: Towards Albury 2050
nodes.description: AlburyCity's Community Strategic Plan adopted March 2025, the highest-order planning document setting long-term community vision across liveability, sustainability and economic development. All operational strategies must align to this plan.

nodes.label: FOGO Kerbside Program
nodes.description: Food organics and garden organics kerbside collection operational since 2015, diverting organic waste from the Southern Valley putrescible cell. Diversion rate has stalled at ~62-63% since launch, requiring IVC or MBT to unlock further gains.

nodes.label: C&D Materials Recovery Facility
nodes.description: Construction and demolition waste materials recovery facility under construction at AWMC at time of WMS (June 2023). Targets recovery of concrete, timber, steel and mixed C&D materials currently going to landfill.

metadata.expectedDiversionContribution: Significant — C&D residual is major landfill volume contributor

nodes.label: In-Vessel Composting Facility (IVC)
nodes.description: Proposed on-site IVC facility to process FOGO and green waste at AWMC, estimated $19.5M capital cost with NPV benefit of $136.8M over 25 years. Siting is subject to EPA regulatory pathway noting previous 2009-2010 EIS rejection for on-site composting.

metadata.sitingConstraint: Previous EPA rejection of composting EIS 2009-2010

nodes.label: Mechanical Biological Treatment Facility (MBT)
nodes.description: Proposed MBT facility to process residual waste and extract recyclables prior to landfilling, estimated $18.8M capital with 2-year construction period. Would address the 11,251t pa residual waste stream currently achieving 0% diversion.

nodes.label: Biogas Generator PPP — LMS Energy
nodes.description: 1.1MW landfill gas-to-energy generator operated by LMS Energy under a public-private partnership, operational since October 2009. Co-located with 1.5MW solar on the capped cell using the same PPP infrastructure.

metadata.emissionsAbatement: Landfill gas destruction — counts toward Scope 1 reduction

nodes.label: Compaction Improvement Program
nodes.description: Operational program to improve waste compaction rates in the Southern Valley putrescible cell to extend usable life toward the 34-year maximum scenario. Directly affects the 2033 trigger date for commencing new site development.

metadata.impactOnLifeExtension: Improved compaction extends toward maximum life scenario

nodes.label: Comprehensive Filling Plan Development
nodes.description: Development of a comprehensive airspace filling plan for AWMC to optimise cell life and inform the timing of new site development. Required under WMS 2023 to manage the 18-34 year life uncertainty of the Southern Valley cell.

metadata.purpose: Optimise airspace use and define new site development trigger date
metadata.linkedDeadline: New site development must begin by 2033 (minimum life scenario)

nodes.label: 100% Renewable Electricity PPA
nodes.description: Power Purchase Agreement for 100% renewable electricity supply to all council facilities from 1 January 2023. Delivers the 2025 renewable electricity target under ESFAP and eliminates Scope 2 market-based emissions.

nodes.label: Council Building Solar — 575kW
nodes.description: 575kW of rooftop solar installed across 18 council facilities, reducing Scope 2 location-based emissions and energy costs. Forms part of the renewable energy generation portfolio alongside the AWMC PPP solar.

nodes.label: Energy Management Framework
nodes.description: Proposed organisational framework to systematically manage and reduce corporate energy consumption across all council operations. Would establish monitoring, reporting and accountability for energy performance toward ESFAP targets.

nodes.label: Carbon KPI Cascade
nodes.description: Proposed cascade of carbon reduction KPIs embedded into business unit performance frameworks across council. Would operationalise ESFAP targets at department level and drive accountability for emission reductions.

metadata.purpose: Embed carbon accountability in operational management

nodes.label: Emergency Preparedness — Climate Hazards
nodes.description: Council actions addressing preparedness for flood, storm, heatwave and fire events as identified in CCAS 2021-2025. These actions are constrained by the strategy's pre-emergency-declaration baseline and require updating.

metadata.constraintNote: Strategy predates March 2022 climate emergency declaration

nodes.label: Commercial Waste Gate Application (AWMC)
nodes.description: Application form for commercial operators seeking access to AWMC for waste disposal or resource recovery services. Required for businesses disposing of scheduled wastes or accessing tipping services above residential rates.

nodes.label: Environment Protection Licence Variation
nodes.description: NSW EPA application pathway for varying an existing Environment Protection Licence to authorise changed or new scheduled activities at AWMC. Required for any new waste processing infrastructure (IVC, MBT) added to the site.

metadata.applicableTo: Existing EPL holders seeking to change licensed activities

nodes.label: Development Application — New Landfill Cell
nodes.description: AlburyCity Planning development application pathway for new landfill cell construction at AWMC. Given 5.5-year minimum lead time, any application for a new cell triggered by the 2033 deadline must be lodged by approximately 2027.

metadata.criticalDeadline: Lodge by ~2027 to meet 2033 site development start

nodes.label: NGER Annual Reporting Submission
nodes.description: Annual greenhouse gas and energy reporting submission to the Clean Energy Regulator under the NGER Act. AlburyCity submits for AWMC and any other facilities meeting the threshold, with data informing ESFAP progress reporting.

metadata.submissionPortal: OSCAR (Online System for Comprehensive Activity Reporting)

nodes.label: Cities Power Partnership Pledge Reporting
nodes.description: Annual pledge reporting to the Cities Power Partnership (CPP) on progress against the council's CPP commitments across renewable energy, energy efficiency, sustainable transport and advocacy. Publicly reported.

nodes.label: Council Budget Submission — Climate Actions
nodes.description: Internal council budget submission process for climate action capital and operating expenditure, including ESFAP actions, fleet transition and energy efficiency upgrades. Submissions compete through the annual Integrated Planning and Reporting cycle.

nodes.label: Resource Recovery Team — AWMC
nodes.description: AlburyCity's operational team responsible for the Albury Waste Management Centre including landfill operations, resource recovery, contractor management and EPL compliance. Primary contact for commercial waste access and gate applications.

nodes.label: NSW Environment Protection Authority
nodes.description: NSW EPA is the regulatory body responsible for issuing and enforcing Environment Protection Licences under the POEO Act, administering the NSW waste levy, and regulating scheduled waste facilities including AWMC.

nodes.label: AlburyCity Planning — Development Applications
nodes.description: AlburyCity Planning team responsible for processing development applications including infrastructure at AWMC. Critical contact for new landfill cell, IVC and MBT development approvals.

nodes.label: Assets Sustainability and Environment Cluster
nodes.description: AlburyCity cluster responsible for sustainability strategy, ESFAP implementation, carbon reporting and climate change adaptation. Primary internal contact for climate-related queries and NGER reporting.

nodes.label: Cities Power Partnership Secretariat
nodes.description: Secretariat for the Cities Power Partnership, a national network of councils committed to clean energy transition. AlburyCity reports annually to CPP and can access peer support, resources and advocacy through this network.

nodes.label: RAMJO — Riverina Murray Joint Organisation
nodes.description: Regional Joint Organisation coordinating shared services and strategy across member councils including AlburyCity. Administers the Regional Resource Recovery Strategy and facilitates collaborative waste infrastructure solutions.

nodes.label: Energy from Waste — NSW Policy Barrier
nodes.description: Energy from Waste (EfW) incineration is not viable in NSW due to state policy position and insufficient waste volumes at AlburyCity scale. Any future EfW project proposal would conflict directly with NSW Government policy and the waste hierarchy prioritising resource recovery over energy recovery.

metadata.conflictingScale: AlburyCity waste volume insufficient for economically viable EfW
metadata.resolution: Pursue IVC, MBT and circular economy alternatives

nodes.label: Previous EPA Rejection — On-site Composting EIS
nodes.description: NSW EPA rejected an EIS for on-site composting at AWMC in 2009-2010. This historical decision creates a regulatory precedent and siting constraint that affects the approval pathway for the proposed IVC facility at the same location.

metadata.resolution: Pre-DA EPA consultation required; updated EIS with contemporary assessment methodology
metadata.note: Changed regulatory and technology context since 2009 may support different outcome

nodes.label: CCAS Predates Climate Emergency Declaration
nodes.description: The Climate Change Adaptation Strategy 2021-2025 was adopted prior to AlburyCity's climate emergency declaration of March 2022 and does not reflect the heightened obligations and urgency that declaration implies. The strategy's risk assessments, action timelines and ambition level have not been revised to reflect post-declaration expectations.

metadata.resolution: CCAS review required — align with emergency declaration obligations and updated IPCC AR6 risk data

nodes.label: Scope 3 Exclusion from Corporate Carbon Targets
nodes.description: ESFAP LSO 2.1 commits to including Scope 3 emissions in future corporate carbon targets, but current reporting excludes Scope 3 entirely. This gap conflicts with Climate Active certification requirements and creates underreporting of AlburyCity's true carbon impact, particularly from procurement and contractor emissions.

metadata.conflictingFramework: Climate Active — requires Scope 1, 2 and 3 for organisation certification
metadata.resolution: Scope 3 inventory development required — prioritise high-spend procurement categories
